verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no app marketplace and no installable prebuilt integrations for Slack, support desks, marketing tools or data warehouses. Webhooks are a developer building block and MCP assistant connections are a different capability, so neither counts here. The Gmail inbox feature is a single built-in integration, not marketplace installs. The llms.txt probe lists an /integrations URL, but nothing in the pack describes what that page contains.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
